title: You cannot clutch what mercy has to give
summary: Let mercy and grace reach the heart before effort strains. Do not let the day outrun this: carry this with you: learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.
takeaway: Return to the gift before turning it into a review.
lifeApplication: When you want instant assurance, unclench the hand, say the Name once, and stop trying to own the experience. Receive before you evaluate.

source.shortMeaning: Naam is received by mercy; the self-willed grip loses it.
source.lifeApplication: Unclench the hand and receive the Name instead of trying to seize it.
